summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a call notice for an Extraordinary General Shareholders Meeting to be held November 30, 2026, entirely by digital means. The sole agenda item is approval of the Company's Stock-Based Long-Term Incentive Plan; no merger, tender, divestiture, or capital transaction is proposed. Shareholders must accredit by November 28, 2026 via investor relations email, submitting identification and representation documents. Meeting materials are posted on the company, CVM, and B3 sites. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; no deal terms or arbitrage angle apply.
